Fort Lauderdale Critical Mass

Fort Lauderdale, FL · Social

Family

Fort Lauderdale Critical Mass is a social group ride in Fort Lauderdale, FL. It rolls last Friday of the month at 7:30 pm from Holiday Park. Pace: c/D, 12–17 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12–17 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Fort Lauderdale Critical Mass group ride

Large social ride around Fort Lauderdale on the last Friday of every month. A few hundred riders on every kind of bike. Slow pace. Starts at Holiday Park. The same Facebook group also lists a smaller Sunday night slow ride from Esplanade Park.
